content: Installer restructured: cleanup.go moved to utils/cleanup (single Cleanup func called before hostPhase and after firstboot), features moved to utils/firstboot (install_config + secureboot + tpm with chmod 755 after copy). hostPhase now 4 steps only. main.go 7-step flow: cleanup-hostPhase-chrootPhase-firstboot-cleanup. Harness: harness.log captures stdout+stderr, LUKS inject uses serialLogLastLineHas (last line only, not count), swtpm restart unconditional

Today: restructured installer lifecycle (cleanup+features out of hostPhase), fixed LUKS inject (last line only), fixed swtpm restart unconditional, harness.log captures both stdout+stderr, test results in tests/ dir. Target boots correctly (TPM+LUKS+btrfs+OpenRC). Harness may be slow waiting for SSH in QEMU. Installer completes successfully.

btrfsUnencrypted layout added: single disk, no LUKS, direct btrfs, same subvolumes as btrfsStandard. Harness checks now layout-aware (storage_layout, kernel_cmdline, secureboot_conf gated on EnableSecureboot). verify.log now markdown summary. harness.log writes run summary at end. chmod 0755 removed from disk layouts. binary naming skea_harness (snake_case).
